tool_input.command: ls ~/.claude-mem 2>/dev/null; f=$(ls ~/.claude-mem/*.db 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; [ -n "$f" ] && sqlite3 "$f" "select id,created_at,prompt_text from user_prompts order by id desc limit 4" 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: Read full text of recent recorded prompts

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext HTTP exception, including for internal hosts.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
